verdict.why: Local observability capture is now on by default in dev instead of opt-in.

draft.detail: In wrangler dev, X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY is now on out of the box; previously opt-in behind X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=true

test.error: FAIL: with X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY unset, wrangler dev passes unsafeObservability: false to Miniflare

source.quote: `wrangler dev` and the Vite plugin now capture request traces and console logs into the Local Explorer's Observability tab out of the box — previously this was opt-in behind `X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=true`.
